fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek to launch 2-nanometer process chipsets in late 2026, strengthening premium market entry; has expanded mobile SoC market share versus Qualcomm over past two years.
fields.summary_ko.1: 5G Open Resource Architecture provides customer-specific chip design customization, raising market entry barriers, but faces share erosion risk from Samsung and Apple in-house SoC design.
